task: In codemie-ui, show each CLI agent folder once in the chat sidebar Folders section by aliasing the registered agent folder name to its import group, matching case-insensitively and treating hyphen/underscore alike, leaving claude and custom folders unchanged.

key_reasoning.reason: The claude legacy-alias path (CHAT_IMPORT_SOURCES -> legacy-import key, hidden when empty) is the closest pattern. No security surface. Moderate risk comes from the folder key scheme shared by many sidebar consumers (FolderList, MoveChatPopup, buildAggregates) and from UnifiedChatSidebar having no tests. Name normalisation (copilot-cli vs copilot_cli, case) is a small new element.
Three components in one front-end tier: chatImportSources constants, chatSidebarFolderHelpers classification, and the useChatSidebarFolders empty-folder filter. The pattern is clear.
